review.summary: Reviewed the complete committed documentation branch against its main-branch merge base for bugs, regressions, security gaps, missing verification, documentation consistency and scope. Both prior Ofelia findings are fixed: ADR-013 records the decision and host-level Docker authority, and G/E/F require scheduler and effective job-runner hardening before activation. Checked 20 Markdown files and 69 local links/anchors, future task checkboxes, SVG XML and whitespace; rendered and visually inspected the revised topology. Only documentation and diagrams changed. No application tests, live host audit, scheduler execution, backup/restore or deployment was performed; those remain future task obligations. No further actionable findings identified. This review is advisory and does not replace human approval.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: ADR-013, deployment guidance and G/E/F now require immutable scheduler/job images, no scheduler network or published ports, confined local socket access, operator-controlled read-only job configuration, non-root execution, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and minimal mounts/secrets. QA must inspect effective API-created runners, and unmet controls block activation. The residual host-level authority of Docker access is explicit; a read-only socket is not presented as API authorization.

ADR-013 now records Ofelia selection, the host-timer alternative, operational-only scope, daily backup and weekly cleanup responsibilities, Docker authority trade-off, mandatory controls and replacement/retirement conditions. Task and deployment links resolve; architecture guidance and the rendered topology reflect the decision.
